about.text: Chinese esports platform channel for League with a data base of team and player statistics (KDA, participation, kills, deaths, assists, GPM, CSPM, damage and vision rates by tournament, team and position), plus match viewing, rankings, champion ranking and a mobile app; the platform covers many other games too.

coverage.text: Multi-game esports site (LoL, Honor of Kings, Dota 2, CS:GO, Overwatch and others in the top menu); the page read is the LoL player-stats table
